_doc: ONE config file for the site. After editing, run: python3 build.py   (then commit + push). An empty link = its button shows 'Coming soon'. Nothing here is secret: all of it is public on the site.
screenshot_alt: Backline in TouchDesigner: the controls screen with MIDI mapping

_notes.buy_url: Polar checkout link of the FULL product (€60, all parts). Set the checkout's success URL to <site>/thanks/.
_notes.trial_url: Polar checkout link of the free (EUR 0) trial product: it gives access to the private repository.
_notes.portal_url: Polar customer portal (buyers free a computer, see their key). Same value as portal_url in core/license.json of the product.
_notes.support_email: Public support address. Empty = the support page says it is coming and points to the in-app report.
_notes.video: Demo video: an https embed URL (YouTube / Vimeo embed link) or a path to an .mp4 inside this repo (under 100 MB). Empty = 'coming soon' slot.
_notes.screenshot: Path of the PERFORM screenshot inside this repo, e.g. assets/perform.jpg. Empty = the screenshot block is left out.
_notes.site_url: Full public URL without trailing slash, e.g. https://org.github.io . Used for canonical links and sitemap.xml. Empty = none.
_notes.base_path: '' for a root site (<org>.github.io), '/backline-site' for a project site. Only used by 404.html.
_notes.legal_draft: true = the EULA / privacy / terms pages show a 'draft, being checked by a lawyer' note. Set false only when the lawyer's OK is in writing (G4).
_notes.guide_skip: Guide section numbers left out of the site (7 = internal known open points).
_notes.video_poster: Still image shown before the .mp4 video plays (path inside this repo). Empty = black frame.
_notes.screenshot_alt: Alt text of the screenshot (what it shows). Empty = default PERFORM description.
_notes.buy_visuals_url: Checkout link of the AV pack (Core + AV + MIDI). Empty = 'Coming soon'.
_notes.buy_lights_url: Checkout link of the Lights Control pack (Core + Lights + MIDI). Empty = 'Coming soon'.
_notes.price: Price of Full; price_visuals / price_lights of the packs; price_from = the lowest (hero button).
_notes.packs_on: Packs on sale, in order: av, lights, full. AV-first launch (DESIGN §4 L): ['av']; add 'lights', 'full' when LIGHTS ships.
_notes.packs_soon: Packs shown as 'Coming soon' (no Buy link). AV-first launch: ['lights', 'full'].
_notes.video_lights: Lights demo reel for the 'coming soon' Lights row: an embed URL or an .mp4 in this repo. Empty = no video.
